## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The save command should surface write failures because an unavailable destination currently produces a success message and status 0. This review read the complete diff, both changed files and their tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds report saving with a destination announcement, optional temporary-report cleanup, and tests for saving and cleanup.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Surface failed report writes — For `missing/report.txt` whose parent directory does not exist, `save_report` swallows `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns 0. The `OSError` handler discards the failure and continues through the success path. — Users and callers receive a success indication even though no report was created, with no information to diagnose the failure. — Fix: Propagate the exception, or report the destination and underlying error and return a nonzero status without announcing success.
